titles.title: ASAP Act
All Stations Accessibility Program Reauthorization Act
ASAP Act

A bill to amend chapter 53 of title 49, United States Code, to provide competitive grants to assist State and local governmental authorities in addressing accessibility needs of legacy rail fixed guideway public transportation systems.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.
